clauses.clause_label: What You May Do — reading, study, discussion, and excerpts
clauses.scope_note: Applies only to repository content owned by Rasmus Thornberg. Reading and studying the code, documentation, examples, and architecture, and publicly discussing the project with attribution, are stated permissions. Copying is limited to small, isolated excerpts; the excerpt must include attribution and must not be presented as the licensee’s original work. No permission is stated for copying larger portions.
clauses.condition_explanation: For the excerpt-copying permission, the use must be personal, educational, or non-commercial, and the attribution and non-presentation requirements also apply. The text does not state those use limits for reading, studying, or publicly discussing the project.

clauses.clause_label: What Requires Prior Written Permission — substantial redistribution and competing versions
clauses.scope_note: Applies to repository content owned by Rasmus Thornberg. Prohibits redistributing substantial portions and publishing a modified version or fork as a competing distribution unless direct written permission from Rasmus Thornberg is obtained. It does not state a blanket prohibition on all redistribution or all private modification.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the licensee lacks direct written permission from Rasmus Thornberg.

clauses.clause_label: What Requires Prior Written Permission — packaging, sale, sublicensing, and commercial exploitation
clauses.scope_note: Applies to packaging, selling, sublicensing, or commercially exploiting repository content owned by Rasmus Thornberg. The restriction is subject to the stated exception for direct written permission; it does not independently establish terms for any permission granted.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the licensee lacks direct written permission from Rasmus Thornberg.

clauses.clause_label: What Requires Prior Written Permission — hosted service
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits offering the project, or a substantial derivative of it, as a hosted service, absent the stated direct written permission. Applies to repository content owned by Rasmus Thornberg.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the licensee lacks direct written permission from Rasmus Thornberg.

clauses.clause_label: What Requires Prior Written Permission — incorporation into commercial product
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits incorporating substantial portions of repository content owned by Rasmus Thornberg into a commercial product, absent the stated direct written permission. The restriction is limited to substantial portions and commercial products.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the licensee lacks direct written permission from Rasmus Thornberg.

clauses.clause_label: What Requires Prior Written Permission — preserving notices
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits removing or obscuring copyright, license, attribution, or provenance notices on repository content owned by Rasmus Thornberg, absent the stated direct written permission. The text does not specify that this restriction applies only upon distribution.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the licensee lacks direct written permission from Rasmus Thornberg.

coverage_notes: The notice identifies this as a limited preview, not an open-source release; permissions and restrictions apply only to repository content owned by Rasmus Thornberg and the repository version where the notice appears (lines 5–6, 41–50).

Third-party dependencies, externally licensed fixtures, generated materials with their own notices, and separately licensed content remain under their own licenses; the referenced THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is not supplied here (lines 41–44).
Broader permissions may be granted case by case in writing, but no additional permission or terms are supplied. Contribution terms are referred to in an unsupplied CONTRIBUTING.md (lines 30–37).
The text grants no trademark or patent rights and disclaims warranty; these do not supply activity permissions (lines 52–53).
